svg.title: Figure 02 · Strike derivatives and the risk-neutral density
svg.desc: S₀ = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%, τ = 1. For a smooth European call price function, its second strike derivative equals e^(−rτ) times the risk-neutral terminal density.
